page.overview:
Who is Black Jaguar?

Black Jaguar is one of the Autobot-allied Beastformers fighting a war on the planet Beest. His role in the Autobot Beastformer forces is head bodyguard. He also holds the rank of King of Nupal, the country in whose mountain region he was born, over Emperor Crowmax... who is fighting on the opposite side in the war. Okay then.
